Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. | CRON 20260929_183159: Kapchorua Tea Company Plc summarised statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 March 2025 (NSE filing, file _nse_pdf/KAPC.pdf), Ksh thousands, two printed columns 2025 and 2024. Operating Profit (EBIT) carries the printed gain from operations before tax 116,545 (FY2025) and 459,567 (FY2024); Profit Before Tax carries the printed profit before taxation 261,543 and 573,297, which ties to EBIT plus the printed increase in fair value of biological assets 100,267 and 86,905 plus printed net finance income 44,731 and 26,825. EPS carries the printed basic and diluted earnings per share of Ksh 23.16 for FY2025, which divides exactly into the printed profit for the year 181,177 over the printed 7,824,000 issued shares. Net Profit FY2025 and FY2024 are corrected to the printed profit for the year 181,177 and 399,358: the stored figures 164,596 and 460,288 were the printed TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE income (profit for the year plus the printed other comprehensive (loss)/income of (16,581) and 60,928), and they failed the file's own arithmetic, because printed profit before taxation 261,543 less the printed tax charge 80,366 equals 181,177. The printed comprehensive income is kept in this file under its own label. FY2023 and FY2022 columns come from the farmed kenyanstocks harvest and are untouched.

No blanks. | EPS FY2025 read from Kapchorua-Tea-Kenya-Plc-Audited-Full-year-Results-2025.pdf | EPS FY2024 read from Kapchorua-Tea-Kenya-Plc-Audited-Full-year-Results-2025.pdf | Operating Profit (EBIT) added from the audited summarised statement for the year ended 31 March 2025, printed as Gain from operations before tax. FY2023 and FY2022 stay empty: the filing carries two columns only. Note that the stored Cost of Sales and Gross Profit carry the fair value movement on biological assets (Revenue less Cost of Sales plus fair value change = Gross Profit), which is why the cost of sales identity alone does not tie for this issuer.
